fields.description: Camden brings one- to three-bedroom apartments and duplex homes to Town Square, near its main park. The published layouts offer a choice of balcony apartments; the developer also advertises duplexes without a separate numerical duplex plan in the retrieved pack.

reviewCoverage.identity: Own Camden page and named brochure agree; no sibling project material adopted.
reviewCoverage.location: Own project page identifies Town Square, Dubai; exact existing registry location used. Repeated generic community claims excluded.
reviewCoverage.residences: Own introduction advertises 1–3 bedrooms and duplex homes. Six numerical apartment families checked; no invented duplex area.
reviewCoverage.areas: All six full official plan panels visually inspected. Printed total built-up ranges retained, including explicit component discrepancies for 2BR B and 3BR A.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Named Camden brochure page 17 visually read; only its six amenities adopted.
reviewCoverage.pricing: No official price list retrieved. Property Finder body gives AED 1,140,888 versus rounded headline AED 1.1m; historical reference only.
reviewCoverage.payment: Own one-page launch sheet visually inspected: five 10% stages plus 50% at indicative handover. Original dates preserved.
reviewCoverage.handover: Own payment sheet indicates March 2028, corroborated by Property Finder. No independently verified construction progress or completion certification obtained.
reviewCoverage.documents: Own 26-page brochure, six-page plans and one-page payment sheet downloaded. Brochure repeats these plan pages; combined PDF allocation 200 words, generic community derivation zero.

overview: The main park is part of Camden’s setting, while the apartment plans provide a more useful basis for comparing individual homes than a broad community size range.
The figures below reproduce printed total built-up areas. A duplex advertisement does not establish a duplex layout or size.
research.locationNote: The developer places Camden in Town Square, Dubai, close to its main park. No unverified journey times or precise plot coordinates are added.
research.priceNote: Property Finder’s project description quotes AED 1,140,888; its headline rounds this to AED 1.1m. An official price list and current available-unit quotation were not retrieved.
research.paymentNote: Original launch calendar; request fresh contractual due dates.
research.handoverNote: Indicative developer target; not confirmed completion.
unresolved: Component/total discrepancies: 2BR B approximately 0.21 sq ft; 3BR A 0.75–0.76 sq ft. Printed totals retained; confirm contractual areas.
Duplex drawings, current stock, service charges, an official price list and independently verified construction progress were not obtained.
The portal’s December 2025 booking timeline conflicts with the developer’s June 2025 payment calendar; those portal start dates are not adopted.
